source: All ACC_STATIC declarations in the HD classfiles, including <clinit>. A row with only hd is unassigned. A target is a logical home. sdCandidate and candidateTarget require source review.

evidence.unique instruction shape: Both method assignments agree; the ordered opcode/operand sequence (with internal member identities erased and object descriptors normalized) and signature have exactly one match in each jar, minimum eight instructions.
evidence.aligned field accesses: At least two distinct paired methods access these fields at identical instruction positions. The collected correspondence is one-to-one in both directions; the first two HD witnesses are listed.
evidence.isolated increment: In the bytecode dump the only read increments the field by one; every other write, if present, stores literal zero.
evidence.two method assignments: Candidate from agreement of the two method surveys with a method-match3 score of at least 0.85.
evidence.matching instruction windows: Candidate from matching nine ordered instructions around the field reference, within two or more agreed method pairs. All such witnesses agree in both directions.
evidence.HD toolkit owner: HD-only static toolkit identified by the architecture survey; class initializer remains in declaration order.
evidence.HD_PLAN §1.3: Explicit method or field use in the HD plan or its cited JAR sources.
